🎉Do you know this historic Viennese restaurant that has a funny name and serves really good schnitzel? Hidden just a short walk from St Stephen's Cathedral is weisserrauchfangkehrer also known as “The White Chimney Sweep”, a traditional Viennese restaurant dating back to at least 1848.
